memoryBuilder.verseText: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.

sequence.prompt: What happened at the wedding? Put it in order.

items.label: Wedding celebration runs out of wine
Mary tells Jesus about the problem
Jesus tells servants to fill water jars

matches.prompt: Match each to what they did.

pairs.right: Obeyed Jesus and filled the jars
Became the best wine of the party

application.question: Mary said: Do whatever Jesus says! What is one thing Jesus tells us to do that you can do today?
application.followUp: When the servants obeyed Jesus, ordinary water became extraordinary wine. When YOU do what Jesus says, ordinary moments become something amazing.
